title: Smartphone Accelerometer and Gyroscope Sleep Tracking Data (Apple / Google)
summary: Continuous overnight motion and orientation streams from smartphone IMU sensors used to infer sleep stages, held by Apple Health and Google Fit on proprietary cloud infrastructure.

title: In-Store Facial Recognition Dwell and Emotion Data (NEC / Verint)
summary: Per-visit facial geometry, dwell time, and inferred emotional state captured by camera arrays in retail environments, held by NEC and Verint on behalf of retailer clients.

title: Electric Vehicle Per-Session Charging Telemetry (ChargePoint / Tesla)
summary: Timestamped location, state-of-charge curves, and energy draw per individual vehicle charging session, held by ChargePoint and Tesla network operators.

title: Smart Electricity Meter 15-Minute Consumption Intervals (National Grid / Enedis)
summary: Sub-hourly household electricity consumption readings from smart meters linked to individual account holders, held by distribution network operators including Enedis and National Grid.

title: Consumer Earbud PPG and Heart Rate Streams (Apple AirPods Pro / Samsung Galaxy Buds)
summary: Photoplethysmography and inferred cardiovascular metrics captured by optical sensors in consumer earbuds during wear, held by Apple and Samsung on health platform backends.

title: Casino Floor RFID Player Tracking and Behavioral Sensor Logs
summary: Per-chip RFID sensor events, bet timing, and facial recognition match records tied to individual loyalty card holders, held by casino operators using Konami and IGT systems.

title: Connected Car Interior Camera Drowsiness and Attention Monitoring (Seeing Machines / Mobileye)
summary: Per-driver gaze vector, eyelid closure rate, and head pose time-series from driver monitoring cameras in production vehicles, held by OEMs and Seeing Machines on fleet telematics platforms.

title: Incarcerated Individual Biometric and Movement Sensor Logs (US Federal BOP)
summary: RFID wristband location pings, door sensor events, and biometric access records tied to individual inmates across federal correctional facilities, held by the Bureau of Prisons.

title: Smart Toilet Urinalysis and Stool Sensor Readings (Toi Labs / Withings)
summary: Per-flush chemical and optical sensor measurements of urine flow, color, and fecal characteristics linked to identified household members, held by Toi Labs and Withings.

title: Corporate Badge Reader Location Traces (Lenel / Honeywell)
summary: Timestamped door access events constituting indoor movement traces for individual employees, held by corporate security departments using Lenel and Honeywell access control systems.

title: US Military Warfighter Physiological Status Monitor Data (DARPA / Army Research Laboratory)
summary: Continuous core temperature, heart rate, and hydration sensor streams from wearable physiological status monitors worn by individual soldiers, held by the Army Research Laboratory under operational security classification.

title: Hearing Aid Acoustic Environment and Usage Logs (Phonak / Starkey)
summary: Continuous ambient sound classification, volume adjustment events, and geolocation-linked acoustic environment logs from internet-connected hearing aids, held by Phonak and Starkey on proprietary cloud platforms.

title: School-Issued Chromebook Camera and Microphone Activity Logs (GoGuardian)
summary: Periodic webcam snapshots and ambient audio activity indicators from student-assigned Chromebooks during remote learning, held by GoGuardian on behalf of school district clients.

title: Home Fertility Monitor LH Surge and Basal Temperature Sensor Records (Clearblue / Ava)
summary: Daily urinary LH concentration readings and overnight wrist temperature curves linked to individual users, held by Clearblue Connected and Ava AG on fertility tracking cloud platforms.

title: Smart Insole Plantar Pressure and Gait Sensor Records (Moticon / Orpyx)
summary: Per-step pressure distribution and cadence time-series from instrumented insoles worn by rehabilitation patients and athletes, held by Moticon and Orpyx on clinical and consumer cloud platforms.
